property_summary: The correct contract calls transferFrom on every address in _tos, while the buggy version skips the last element, so for any input the correct contract processes all _tos.length calls and the buggy one processes _tos.length-1 calls.
change_summary: Replace the loop condition 'i<_tos.length' with 'i<_tos.length-1' so the last element is never processed.
